nodes.label: Ruling on 26c-02 - (c), a third state
nodes.rationale: M did not choose between the two drafted options because the choice 26c-02 offered was between the wrong two objects: 375 does not originate the 47 - register 332 does, and 332 is the entry 32.1.4 already cites. Neither (a) nor (b) would have reached the entry that carries the figure.

nodes.label: Ruling on 27a-02 - (a), the column names entries that rest on the section
nodes.rationale: The ruling settles the column's standard, not its contents. No row may be written from a token probe: DEP requires the deciding phrase asserted present in the entry's own text.

nodes.label: Ruling on 28a-06 - (a), re-take on the list it is printed beside
nodes.rationale: Fifty-nine becomes 52 with a new entry citing 1736, which must record what 1736 remains right about - its own figure is a 172-row datum and it is not withdrawn. The new entry must not cite the 16, which 28a-08 measured to be no bound at all.

nodes.label: Ruling on 28b-07 - (b), the lead-ins stop claiming dependence
nodes.rationale: Main L11808 and L11854 are re-worded to name what is true as printed - the works ENTERED WITH the chapters at registers 1701-1712 and 1713-1724. Montgomery's sentence at L11821 stands. Deliberate consequence: the six post-2015 works and Madelung stay in the blocks, and scope questions about them do not recur because the block stops making the claim.

nodes.label: Finding 32a-03 - the section 2.21 readout class
nodes.rationale: Eight scripts including numbers-index.py and densities.py are not members, and register 435 records the first two as absent and rebuilt from the printed rules. Every section 2.21 build readout is therefore a figure no member of the artefact can recompute. This is not a defect in any figure; it is the honest standing of all seven.

nodes.label: Finding 32a-04 - register 332's body is damaged
nodes.rationale: Two sentences collapsed with text lost between 'indices' and 'since', exactly where the entry would state how many named cells have since been filled. Append-only: a new entry citing 332 states the loss rather than filling it, because the figure is held nowhere this reading found.
